A [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] '''smuggler''' was captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and was transformed into a wild beast by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Vader did this by burning the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] mind with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side of the Force]], causing the transformation to occur. Driven by fear, the Gotal served the Sith Lord as a guard. The Gotal later met another smuggler named [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] in the underground catacombs of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].
